subject.title: fix(slack): bound userCache growth with pruneMapToMaxSize

question: Is the contributor’s operator-confirmed revocation or rotation and evidence scrubbing sufficient to close the earlier Slack credential exposure before this PR proceeds?
rationale: Credential revocation occurred outside the repository and cannot be proven by code review, so human acceptance of the incident disposition is required.

options.title: Accept and revalidate
options.body: Accept the operator confirmation, clear the waiting-on-author state, rerun or diagnose the exact-head test-type gate, and merge if required checks pass.

options.title: Require stronger confirmation
options.body: Pause merge until an authorized operator or security owner privately confirms that every exposed credential was revoked and no active secret remains.

recommendation.title: Accept and revalidate
recommendation.body: Accept the operator confirmation, clear the waiting-on-author state, rerun or diagnose the exact-head test-type gate, and merge if required checks pass.
